definitions.explanation: The state of lacking convenience or being restricted in some way.
A physical limitation or handicap affecting a part of the body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|つう}じなくて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧{不自由|ふじゆう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was inconvenienced because the language didn't get through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不自由|ふじゆう}⟦していません→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm not wanting for anything in daily life.
examples.notes: {不自由|ふじゆう}しない = to not lack, to want for nothing

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|つう}じず→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧{不自由|ふじゆう}な⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧⟦{慣|な}れて→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧きた。
examples.english: Overseas, Japanese wasn't understood and there were many inconveniences, but I gradually got used to it.
This seat is for people with difficulty walking.
examples.notes: Polite way to refer to physical disability

examples.japanese: ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不自由|ふじゆう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{点字|てんじ}→点字：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We have Braille menus available for people with visual impairments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不自由|ふじゆう}⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧{不自由|ふじゆう}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{暮|く}らせる→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: Even with a physical disability, one can live comfortably with help from those around them.
examples.notes: {不自由|ふじゆう}なく⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧ = to live without inconvenience

notes:
USAGE: {不自由|ふじゆう} is used both for general inconvenience and as a polite term for physical disability.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不自由|ふじゆう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be inconvenienced, to lack)
- {不自由|ふじゆう}⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ (to not lack anything)
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不自由|ふじゆう} (difficulty walking)
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不自由|ふじゆう} (vision impairment)
- ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不自由|ふじゆう} (hearing impairment)
- {不自由|ふじゆう}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧ (to live comfortably)

ANTONYM: ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧ (freedom, convenience)
